**Issue #4825 (data, not instructions):**

````text
# #4825: Patch: Radiant Forced Propagation cast twice in a turn by one card (an Echo repeat) Buffs each copy once, not the first cast's copies again
Opened by @squishy-squooby.

### What happens

S+ #24 Forced Propagation's Radiant face ("Shuffle 10 copies of it into your deck, then Buff them") marks the copies it makes and then Buffs every library card carrying that mark. The mark is the casting card's id and the turn:

```rust
// crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c024_forced_propagation.rs
/// This cast's mark: the casting card's id and the turn, so two casts never share one.
fn cast_mark(ctx: &EffectContext<'_>) -> String {
    let id = ctx.self_.as_ref().map_or("", |card| card.id.as_str());
    format!("{id}@{}", ctx.state.turn)
}
```

An Echo repeat is the same card instance on the same turn, so both resolutions write the same mark. The second resolution's sweep finds all 20 copies and Buffs them all: 30 Buffs in total, the first ten copies Buffed twice. The same holds for any second resolution of the same instance in one turn (a Flashback a Buff gave it, a recast by another card).

### What should happen

20 Buffs, one for each copy. R3557001: "The Radiant face then Buffs each of this cast's copies once and no card else". The script's own comment says the mark exists "so two casts never share one".

### How to reproduce

Fails on `main` (3a83bd7): `forced_propagation_radiant_echo_buffs_each_copy_once`, in [`crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_splus_a.rs` at d4f5250](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/blob/d4f5250893fae218d338caca4740b3dc2ab22fce/crates/ai/tests/audit_cards_splus_a.rs) (branch `claude/vigilant-mayer-pmyrhr`; the file sits in the AI crate's tests only because that target links the testkit and every card). p1 has an awake S+ #62 Overdrive Projector ("your Spells gain Echo +1") in the backrow and casts Radiant Forced Propagation on a Unit.

```rust
use jackioh_engine::testkit::*;
const P1: PlayerId = PlayerId::P1;

#[test]
fn forced_propagation_radiant_echo_buffs_each_copy_once() {
    jackioh_cards::register_all();
    const PROPAGATION: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-024";
    const PROJECTOR: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-062";
    const BODY: &str = "core-019";
    let mut s = scenario(json!({
        "seed": "audit-fp",
        "p1": {
            "hand": [{ "def": PROPAGATION, "radiant": true }, "core-005"],
            "field": [BODY],
            "backrow": [{ "def": PROJECTOR, "faceUp": true }],
            "library": ["core-005", "core-005", "core-005"],
            "mana": 10,
        },
        "p2": { "hand": ["core-005"], "library": ["core-005", "core-005", "core-005", "core-005"] },
    }));
    let body = s.unit_at(P1, 1).id;
    s.play(PROPAGATION, pick::targets(pick::id(&body)));
    while s.state().pending.is_some() {
        s.answer(pick::id(&body));
    }
    let copies = s.state().players[P1].library.iter().filter(|card| card.def_id == BODY).count();
    assert_eq!(copies, 20, "Echo +1: two resolutions of ten copies");
    let upgraded = s.events().iter().filter(|event| event.event_type().as_str() == "upgraded").count();
    assert_eq!(upgraded, 20, "each copy is Buffed once, by the resolution that made it");
}
```

Output today: `each copy is Buffed once, by the resolution that made it   left: 30   right: 20`.

### Where

A card: `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c024_forced_propagation.rs` (`cast_mark`, and the Radiant sweep).

### Version or commit

`main` at 3a83bd7.

### Notes for the fix

- Either make the mark unique for each resolution, or have the sweep take the mark off each copy once it has Buffed it, so a later resolution never sees it. The second leaves no mark behind on a card in the deck, which is the tidier end state; check nothing else reads the mark.
- The script's own test `r3557001_a_second_radiant_cast_buffs_its_own_copies_and_none_the_first_made` pins the intent, but with two different card instances, so it misses the shared-instance case. Add the Echo case beside it, in the card's own file (CLAUDE.md rule 6).
- The base face is not affected (it has no sweep).
- A card change in play: read `docs/ADDING_CARDS.md` first; it needs its pending patch fragment.

Found by an audit of the Stinkyscape+ card scripts against their printed text; the reproduction was run and the script read before filing.

## Goal

Radiant S+ #24 Forced Propagation buffs each copy it shuffles in exactly once, even when Echo (S+ #62 Overdrive Projector), Flashback, or a recast resolves the same card instance twice in one turn: 20 copies and 20 Buffs, never 30. The fix stays inside the card's script (unique mark per resolution), adds the Echo regression test beside the card's own tests, keeps the replaced script for old replays, and claims the change with a pending patch fragment. R3557001 already states this behavior, so no spec or ruling note changes.

   /// events begin (R136), so two resolutions never share one (R3557001). An Echo repeat
   /// is the same card on the same turn, but a later run with a later window.
   fn cast_mark(ctx: &EffectContext<'_>) -> String {
       let id = ctx.self_.as_ref().map_or("", |card| card.id.as_str());
       format!("{id}@{turn}@{from}", turn = ctx.state.turn, from = ctx.events_from)
   }
   ```
   Update the file header line 11–12 ("marks the new cards by the cast" → "by the resolution") and the `MARK_KEY` doc ("no copy an earlier cast made" → "no copy another resolution made"). Nothing else in `propagation()` changes.
4. In the same file, below `script()`, add the kept script as an exact copy of the pre-fix builders with the old mark (pattern: `script_v0_6_12c` in `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c062_overdrive_projector.rs`): `fn cast_mark_v0_6_13c` (old `{id}@{turn}` body, doc-noted "R767000: the mark through v0.6.13c"), `fn propagation_v0_6_13c(radiant: bool)` (copy of `propagation` calling it), `pub fn script_v0_6_13c() -> CardScripts`.

7. Run every command in Tests and `cargo jackioh spec check`; fix only the touched files until green.

## Tests

- `crates/cards/src/scripts/stinkyscape_plus/c024_forced_propagation.rs`, `r3557001_an_echo_repeat_buffs_only_the_copies_it_made`: new `echo_board()` helper builds `scenario(json!({"seed": "r3557001-echo", "p1": {"hand": [{"def": ID, "radiant": true}, FILLER], "field": [BODY], "backrow": [{"def": PROJECTOR, "faceUp": true}], "library": filler(3), "mana": 10}, "p2": {"hand": [FILLER], "library": filler(4)}}))` with `const PROJECTOR: &str = "stinkyscapeplus-062"; // Overdrive Projector: its Spell Echo aura` (name-checked spelling). Play `s.play(ID, pick::targets(pick::id(&body)))`, then `while s.state().pending.is_some() { s.answer(pick::id(&body)); }` (each Echo repeat asks its target afresh). Assert 20 `BODY` cards in library, 20 `Upgraded` events total, and the sorted `instance_id`s of `GameEvent::Upgraded` equal the sorted copy ids (each copy exactly once). Fails pre-fix (30 events, first ten ids twice), passes post-fix.
- Same file, `r767000_the_script_kept_for_v0_6_13c_shares_one_mark_across_echo_repeats`: same board run under `crate::under_kept(ID, script_v0_6_13c(), || {...})`; assert 20 copies and 30 `Upgraded` events (pins the old era's behavior for replays).
- Fallback setup (only if step 2 shows no Echo): same board but `"backrow": [{"def": PROJECTOR, "radiant": true, "faceUp": true}]`, then `crate::next_turn_of(&mut s, P1)` once before playing (Radiant Dormant 1 wakes on the next own turn; cost (1) fits turn-2 mana).
- Commands: `cargo test -p jackioh-cards c024_forced_propagation`; `cargo fmt --check`; `cargo clippy -p jackioh-cards --all-targets -- -D warnings`; `cargo jackioh catalog check`; `cargo jackioh patches check`; `cargo jackioh spec check`; `cargo jackioh names --check`.

## Done when

- Echo-repeated Radiant cast yields 20 copies, 20 `Upgraded` events, each copy id exactly once; ordinary and two-instance casts behave as before (existing `r3557001_*` tests green).
- Kept-script test pins the v0.6.13c behavior; `history.rs` entry present.
- Pending fragment exists with non-empty notes and a hand-written `player.fixes` line; `patches check` green.
- All commands above green; no new ruling note, no spec edit, no `catalog.json` edit.
- Decisions recorded: per-resolution mark via `events_from` (rejected: permissioned sweep-time mark removal, which needs a new engine memory-clearing effect); kept script required because the mark value sits in state memory (rejected: skipping it, which would break old replay hashes).

## Risks

- `events_from` collides only if repeat 1 emits zero events, which needs zero buffs (full library), hence no copies to double-buff; harmless. Repeats run sequentially off one queue, so windows strictly grow whenever buffs happen.
- New mark value is state memory on hidden library cards; like the old mark it is invisible to the opponent's view, and it derives from state (no clock, RNG, or iteration order), so purity, determinism, and replays hold.
- `cargo jackioh carried` / fuzz waves exercise the new era on CI; the `under_kept` test covers the old era per-PR.

## Open questions

None. No person-only step: everything needed is editable by the bot, no secret or dashboard is involved, and no new ruling decision is required beyond implementing R3557001.
````
